'''Jason''' is a male Syncronist student being followed by a Preparatory Program student, '''Shingo'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Jason:''' You've been following me for quite a while now.
:'''Shingo:''' Sorry... I just wanted to see what makes Synchronists different...
:'''Shingo:''' No creepy stuff, I promise! Look, these are my notes—
:'''Shingo:''' Wake up at 7:30 AM, wash and dress in under a minute, scar down breakfast in five, and absolutely no sweets... Is giving up sugar the price of becoming a Synchronist?
:'''Jason:''' Okay, first off, please stop. And I've only been cutting sugar recently.
:'''Jason:''' There's nothing different about Synchronists. We laugh and cry, fight over cafeteria food, stress about exams... And if you punch me, I'll bruise like anyone else.
:'''Jason:''' I guess we're all good at different things. Some of us happen to be wired for piloting.
:'''Shingo:''' I understand... Then how do I get as strong as you? You're at the top of the Voidmatter Enviornment Combat Test every year!
:'''Shingo:''' Is it because you do 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run every day?
:'''Jason:''' Staying fit never hurts. But take it at your own pace. That's just my own personal routine...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* The "100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run every day" is a reference to the web comic/manga/anime, ''One Punch Man''.
